rules.statement: The obligation under a mortgage is indivisible, and thus a payment of interest by one mortgagor would be considered as a payment on behalf of all.
rules.supporting_quote: "By our law, following in that respect the Roman Law and differing from the English law, in a case of doubt the contract if divisible, is presumed to be rather a simple joint obligation (an obligation pro rata) than one in solidum" - Wessels, Law of Contract (page 488, section 1489)
